name: canvas-tools
description: Student-focused Canvas tracking, guarded Overleaf homework setup, and explicit Todoist reconciliation.

interface.shortDescription: Track Canvas work and prepare it in Overleaf.
interface.longDescription: Packages Canvas MCP in a student-only profile for courses, assignments, deadlines, grades, peer reviews, guarded assignment submissions, exact-source Overleaf homework setup, and explicit duplicate-safe Todoist reconciliation.
defaultPrompt: Use $canvas-student-planning to show what I have due this week.
Use $canvas-overleaf-homework to build this Canvas assignment in Overleaf and link it in Todoist.
Use $canvas-student-planning to submit this assignment after showing the exact preview.
